reviewer: Codex deut_4_6 (AI-assisted supplied-English curation for Judges6–10)
review_method: Read all175 complete actual source units and all retained targets with necessary context before completing the curated pass. Separately displayed and reread all180 complete source/target/category/rationale triples in chapter slices; when a combined output cut the middle of chapter10, separately redisplayed and reread that entire chapter. Read full Exodus3:1-12,4:1-9,32:1-6,14:30-31 and20:2; Judges2:11-19,3:9-10/28,11:4-11,12:1-3/13-15 and13:15-23; Deuteronomy7:5,8:17-18,20:8 and32:37-38;1Samuel7:3-10,8:4-9,14:15-23 and31:1-6;2Samuel11:18-21;2Kings14:8-10;Genesis33:18-20;Joshua24:8/14-15/23-24;Proverbs15:1, alongside the complete retained local narrative. Preserved original draft and exact eleven scope/agency/place/purpose refinements, separately displayed and reread every final changed triple, and granted no new credit for changes. Same-chapter links use particular commands and their performance, paired drinking/fleece tests, explicit speech and response, differing narrator/accuser perspectives, the trees fable and its stated application, and announced judgment with its narrated outcome. Retained the source thirteen servants, Tribunal of Baal wording without turning it into a personal renaming, Ephrathah, north-of-Gideon camp, thirty-two sons/donkeys/cities, young-donkey count differences, the final divine displeasure and weariness, and supplied ruler/mother/place-name forms. No exhaustive discovery, independent human, Greek/Hebrew, apparatus or archaeological verification is claimed.
pin_method: Fresh raw fetch of all nine source/target books at the fixed Saints-Translation commit. Rehashed exact Git blob bytes against existing source registries, saved original raw files, and verified complete parsed cache equality; normalized cache-byte differences are recorded separately.
